title: About
heading: A little about me.
subheading: Bilingual psychotherapist. Culturally sensitive care. Space to explore your authentic self.
name: Xiuyun (Sharon) Miao, LCSW
body: I'm Xiuyun (Sharon) Miao, a Licensed Clinical Social Worker licensed in New York, New Jersey, and California. I offer therapy in English and Mandarin for anxiety, depression, trauma, self-esteem, intimacy, and relationship concerns. I earned my Master of Social Work at New York University in 2018.
secondary: My work is especially attentive to the experiences of Asian, Asian American, and other BIPOC clients. Together, we can explore how culture, family expectations, past experiences, and relationships shape the way you see yourself, while making room for your own needs and strengths.
philosophy: Trauma is not a life sentence. It is a wound — and wounds, given the right conditions, can heal. My work is grounded in the conviction that every person, no matter what they've been through, carries within them the capacity for recovery.
I work slowly and carefully, following your nervous system's lead. There is no rushing here, no agenda to push through. We go at the pace that feels safe — and we adjust as we go.
I also believe that the therapeutic relationship itself is healing. The experience of being truly seen, heard, and held — without judgment — is often the most transformative part of the work.
